description: This file defines a React component 'Explore' that renders a page displaying posts in an infinite scroll layout. It manages state for loaded items, cursor for pagination, loading status, and completion state. The component fetches data from an external API service, 'fetchExplore', and displays posts using 'PostCard' within a 'MasonryGrid'. It also implements infinite scrolling with an IntersectionObserver.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches additional explore items from the API, appends new items to the state, updates the cursor, and sets done flag when no more items are available.
